about.name: Tom Bertomeu
about.subtitle:
Master's student in Software Architecture & Development (EADL) at cs2i Bourgogne, after completing a Computer Science degree (BUT) at IUT Nord Franche-Comté in 2026. On a work-study contract at GEN'IAtest since August 2025, I split my time between school and a company: real production code, real deadlines, and actual users alongside the curriculum.

I build fullstack web and mobile apps: React, Next.js, Vue.js, Nuxt, TypeScript on the frontend, various backends. The details that usually get cut (accessibility, edge cases, performance on real devices) are the ones I care about most. Outside of code: motorsport and video games.

The contact form sends your name, email address and message to Formspree, which forwards them to the publisher by email. This data is used only to answer your request; it is neither shared nor reused for any other purpose.
